director.text: Namaste Riya, main Asha, tumhari AI teacher hoon. Aaj cricket pitch jaisi number line par fractions dekhenge. Tumhe cricket mein kya pasand hai?
Riya, maan lo pitch ko 4 barabar parts mein baanta; ball halfway tak gayi. Tum us jagah ka fraction kya sochogi? Baad mein Golu ko sikhaogi.
Bilkul Riya, lesson ek minute ruk sakta hai. Kis baare mein baat karna chahti ho? Screen ka button humein lesson par laayega.
Theek hai Riya, wapas fractions par: 0 se 1 tak 2 over 5 ke liye 5 barabar gaps banao. Pehla gap kitna hoga?
Riya, 0 aur 1 ke beech 5 equal gaps hain, isliye har gap 1 over 5 ka hoga. Ab 2 over 5 ke liye do gaps gino—kahan pahunchogi?
Riya, number-line race khelo: 0 se 1 tak 5 equal jumps; har jump ek-fifth. Do jumps karke kis fraction par ruko?
Game ne 3 jumps register kiye—tum 3 over 5 par pahunchi. Ab 2 over 5 ke liye kitne jumps chahiye?
Riya, yeh part boring lag raha hai—format badalte hain: picture, cricket story, ya bolkar game? Tum ek choose karo.
Riya, kaunsa choose karogi: picture dikhao, kahani mein batao, ya game khelte hain?
Cricket story mode: number line ko pitch samjho, aur har equal gap ek run. Khaali jagah bharo: Check: 2/5 is ___ the middle, because 2/5 is less than 1/2.
